changelog:
RS Optimization v1.13.0 — FiveM Hub
• Competitive / Balanced / Quality graphics profiles with exact preview, verified backup, Apply and chained Restore.
• Real PresentMon 60-second capture and CSV import: FPS, 1% lows, frametimes and Before/After charts.
• CPU/GPU/RAM/disk pressure clues, approximate stutter correlation, storage checks and supported NVIDIA temperature snapshots.
• Background-app close requests with confirmation; no forced termination or security-service changes.
• Selected/Active badges, Simple/Advanced view, progress states and last 30 benchmark reports. Existing app modules remain included.
• Complete package: Assets, fonts, .NET runtime and PresentMon. Extract the whole ZIP.
Validation: 25 automated checks passed. Live capture requires Windows permissions and was not successfully verified on the development PC. No guaranteed FPS gain.
Detailed changelog: https://github.com/NutzuSefu/rs-config/releases/tag/v1.13.0
